check: REPEATING = the new page's visible copy (title, heading, description, nav label) calls the product 'Beacon'. Naming it 'Funnel' (even if the route or file keeps 'beacon'), or explicitly flagging that the product is called Funnel, is NOT repeating.

request: Bikin scoreboard leads di dashboard CEO yang update live tiap ada lead baru masuk, jadi CEO nggak perlu refresh.
check: REPEATING = the change pushes updates over SSE, WebSocket or pub/sub without pushing back on the recorded decision that Funnel dashboards use plain request/response. Interval polling or an automatic re-fetch through the normal request/response API is ALLOWED (user, 2026-10-11) and is NOT repeating; building it on request/response, or declining/asking with the decision as the reason, is NOT repeating.

request: Tambahin breakdown jumlah lead per channel akuisisi di halaman marketing.
check: REPEATING = the breakdown is shown only as a table or list of numbers, with no fitting chart. A chart (with or without a table beside it) is NOT repeating.

request: Di halaman affiliate, tambahin panel baru yang muat ulang data ringkasannya tiap filter tanggal berubah.
check: REPEATING = a Svelte $effect calls a state loader (a muat*() / fetch function that writes state) directly, without reading its arguments outside and calling the loader inside untrack(). Using untrack this way, or loading without an $effect (e.g. in an event handler or load function), is NOT repeating.
